newsitem.title: CANADA: Schneider sees profits under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Schneider sees profits under pressure.

text.p: Food maker Schneider Corp said profits will remain under pressure from increasing production costs for the rest of 1996.
"The outlook for the balance of the year is continuing pressure on profitability as a result of higher costs," the company said in a statement after posting a third-quarter loss.
Schneider lost C$0.22 a share in the third quarter ended August 3, compared to a year-earlier profit of C$0.28 a share.
"Schneider Corporation results for the third quarter continued to be adversely impacted by high hog costs," it said.
For the nine-month period, Schneider lost C$0.28 a share compared to a year-ago profit of C$0.74.
"Competitive pressure prevented us from increasing selling prices on our products quickly enough to compensate for rapidly escalating pork raw material costs," it said.
"These declines were offset somewhat by better profitability in our poultry and baked goods business," it said.
